label: technology
name: Technology Image Category Classification
description: Classify a non-OCR technology image into one or more detailed categories based on the visible device, electronic hardware, machinery, computing equipment, or technical system.

labels.computer: An image primarily showing a desktop computer, monitor, keyboard, computer setup, or workstation.
labels.laptop: An image primarily showing a laptop or notebook computer in use or as part of a technical setup.
labels.smartphone: An image primarily showing a smartphone or mobile device being used in a technical or digital context.
labels.tablet: An image primarily showing a tablet computer or touchscreen device.
labels.robot: An image primarily showing a robot, robotic arm, automated machine, or humanoid robotic system.
labels.drone: An image primarily showing a drone or unmanned aerial vehicle.
labels.circuit_board: An image primarily showing a printed circuit board, electronic board, chips, wires, or internal hardware components.
labels.electronic_components: An image primarily showing electronic parts such as processors, sensors, resistors, cables, batteries, or connectors.
labels.server_equipment: An image primarily showing servers, server racks, data-center equipment, or computer storage systems.
labels.networking_equipment: An image primarily showing routers, switches, antennas, network cables, or communication hardware.
labels.machinery: An image primarily showing industrial machinery, mechanical systems, manufacturing equipment, or automated production machines.
labels.laboratory_equipment: An image primarily showing scientific instruments, testing equipment, microscopes, or laboratory machines.
labels.camera_equipment: An image primarily showing a camera, lens, tripod, lighting equipment, or professional imaging setup.
labels.smart_device: An image primarily showing a connected electronic device such as a smartwatch, smart speaker, smart-home device, or wearable technology.
labels.virtual_reality: An image primarily showing a virtual-reality headset, controllers, or a person using VR equipment.
